subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT a part of resource planning?

options.text: Matching the resource development plans with overall national development plans
Managing people working in an organisation
Identification and inventory of resources across the regions of the country
Evolving a planning structure endowed with appropriate technology, skill and institutional set up for implementing resource development plans

solution:
The correct answer is__** Managing people working in an organization.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Resource development planning** implies a **deliberate process** to prepare for the future.
 
• Planning can be a **difficult, drawn-out process** that requires the assistance of** outside advisors.**
 
• Alternately, it could be **practical, straightforward, and integrated **into your organization's** current internal procedures.**
 
• Planning for resources entails using** tactics and strategies** to use our** nation's resources wisely **and effectively.
 
• **Resource allocation planning** is crucial because it guarantees that resources are** distributed more or less fairly at the national, regional, and local levels.**
 
• As it seeks **alternate development techniques** that attempt to **conserve resources **for **both the present and future generations,** it also ensures **sustainable development.**
 
• It is crucial to coordinate the** plans for resource development **with the **general plans for national development, **which entails comparing the **overall budgets** set aside for **resource development** with those set aside for national development.
 
• The **budgetary resources **of our nation must not be** overextended by further resource development.**
